fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has declined 15% from its record close of $649.42 on October 6 to the current mid-$550s, with management targeting annual revenue growth of 35% or more and non-GAAP EPS of $20 or more through 2030.
fields.summary_ko.1: Achieving the target requires approximately 3x growth from 2025 adjusted EPS of $4.17, and management expressed confidence in exceeding the target through Helios AI system shipments and 6-gigawatt agreements with OpenAI and Meta.
